{{Quote|At Sooncanoo Beacon, the enemy massacred every crewmember of the Fortieth Flotilla when a bold gambit to boost their shields failed and left them dead in space.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Sooncanoo Beacon''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]].<ref name="Author's Cut" /> It was situated in the [[Sooncanoo system/Legends|Sooncanoo system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Northern" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

During the [[Waymancy Storm]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the [[Fortieth Flotilla]] of the Republic underwent a risky attempt to boost the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of its [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at Sooncanoo Beacon. The attempt failed, leaving the [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] to float powerless in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Subsequently, one of the parties affiliated with the Republic's enemy in the war, the [[Signatories of Waymancy]], [[Massacre at Sooncanoo Beacon|massacred]] every crewmember of the Fortieth Flotilla. At a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]], the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] noted the massacre at Sooncanoo Beacon as one of the [[Blood/Legends|bloodiest]] events of the Waymancy Storm.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sooncanoo Beacon was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the beacon, authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], was cut before the book's release. The information regarding Sooncanoo Beacon was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sooncanoo [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Sooncanoo Beacon, in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
